--accept-hooks.help: Auto-approve unseen shell hooks without a TTY prompt (equivalent to HERMES_ACCEPT_HOOKS=1 / hooks_auto_accept: true).

--access-token.help: Provide the new token non-interactively (default: masked prompt)

--ack.help: Acknowledge a security advisory by ID and exit. After ack, the advisory will no longer trigger startup banners. Run `hermes doctor` first to see active advisories and their IDs.

--add-skill.help: Append a skill without replacing the existing list. Repeatable.

--after.help: Only match sessions started at/after TIME (duration ago like '5h', or ISO timestamp)

--agent.help: Disable no-agent mode on this job (reverts to LLM-driven execution).

--agent-view.help: Emit Slack's Agent messaging experience (agent_view, app_home_opened + message.im) instead of the legacy assistant_view experience. This changes Slack's app messaging surface and cannot be reversed in Slack after applying the manifest.

--alias.help: Create a shell wrapper alias for the installed profile

--all-unmanaged.help: Adopt every curation-eligible skill that has no provenance marker

--allow-partial.help: Best-effort salvage across damaged row ranges; the output remains separate and every skipped range is recorded

--allow-tool-override.help: Grant this plugin permission to replace built-in tools (e.g. shell_exec, write_file). Skips the confirmation prompt.

--apply.help: Write the new titles (default: dry run)

--args.help: Arguments for stdio command; must be the last option

--assignee.help: Only show events for tasks assigned to this profile

--auth-url.help: Print OAuth URL for user to visit

--author.help: Author name recorded on the audit comment (default: $HERMES_PROFILE or 'decomposer')

--auto.help: Auto-generate description via the auxiliary LLM (uses auxiliary.profile_describer)

--background.help: Start the LLM review pass in a background thread and return immediately

--backup.help: Force a FULL pre-update backup (quick state snapshot + HERMES_HOME zip) for this run, regardless of updates.pre_update_backup

--before.help: Only match sessions started before TIME (duration ago like '5h', or ISO timestamp like '2026-07-05 14:30')

--binary-path.help: Absolute path to the op binary (skips PATH lookup)

--board.help: Board slug to operate on. Defaults to the current board (set via `hermes kanban boards switch <slug>` or the HERMES_KANBAN_BOARD env var). Use `hermes kanban boards list` to see all boards.

--branch.help: Branch name for worktree tasks, e.g. wt/t6-wire

--build-only.help: Build the desktop app but do not launch it (used by the installer's --update flow)

--ca-bundle.help: Custom CA bundle for OAuth login

--capability.help: Filter by declared capability (e.g. tools, platform, commands)

--chat-type.help: Originating source chat_type, recorded so the active-wake delivery modes resolve the operator's real session. Omit to leave an existing sub unchanged (new subs default to 'dm').

--check.help: Verify ACP dependencies and adapter imports, then exit

--checkpoints.help: Enable filesystem checkpoints before destructive file operations (use /rollback to restore)

--ci.help: Exit non-zero when validation reports an error

--clear-skills.help: Remove all attached skills from the job

--clone.help: Copy config.yaml, .env, SOUL.md, and skills from active profile

--clone-all.help: Full copy of active profile (all state, excluding per-profile history)

--clone-from.help: Source profile to clone from; implies --clone unless --clone-all is set

--color.help: Optional hex color (e.g. '#8b5cf6') for the dashboard

--connect-timeout.help: Timeout in seconds for initial connection and tool discovery

--connector-url.help: The connector base/relay URL, e.g. wss://connector.example.com/relay or https://connector.example.com. Also settable via GATEWAY_RELAY_URL / gateway.relay_url in config.yaml.

--consolidate.help: Force the LLM umbrella-building consolidation pass on for this run, overriding the config default (off). Without this flag the run is prune-only unless `curator.consolidate: true` is set.

--content.help: The evidence content (commit SHA, API response excerpt, etc.)

--content-type.help: MIME type (default: guessed from the file extension)

--context.help: Max tokens Honcho returns from session.context() per turn

--continue.help: Resume a session by name, or the most recent if no name given

--create-if-missing.help: With -c/--continue <name>: if no session matches the name, create a new session with that title and proceed (instead of failing with a not-found error). Programmatic callers that want 'send to this named thread, making it if needed'.

--cwd.help: Only match sessions whose working directory is under this path

--db.help: Path to an alternate session database (default: ~/.hermes/state.db)

--default-workdir.help: Default workspace path for tasks created on this board

--delete.help: Hard-delete the board directory instead of archiving it. Default is to move it to boards/_archived/ so it's recoverable.

--delete-after-verified.help: md/qmd only: after verified single-session export, delete that session (needs --yes)

--deliver-chat-id.help: Target chat ID for cross-platform delivery

--deliver-only.help: Skip the agent — deliver the rendered prompt directly as the message. Zero LLM cost. Requires --deliver to be a real target (not 'log').

--delivery-mode.help: How the kanban-notifier reacts to terminal events for this subscription: 'notify' (passive message only; default), 'notify+wake' (message AND wake the destination gateway agent so it reads the full board context and replies in its own voice), or 'wake' (wake the agent only, no passive message). Omit to leave an existing subscription's mode unchanged (new subs default to 'notify').

--description.help: Human-readable description shown in /help and `hermes bundles list`

--detect-only.help: Only detect and print the recipe as JSON; run nothing

--dev.help: With --tui: run TypeScript sources via tsx (skip dist build)

--dialectic.help: Max chars of dialectic result to inject into system prompt

--diff-base.help: Git ref to diff against (only flag emails from commits after this ref)

--dry-run.help: Show what would be purged without deleting

--enable.help: Auto-enable the plugin after install (skip confirmation prompt)

--enabled-only.help: Only include plugins currently in plugins.enabled

--end-reason.help: Only match sessions with this end reason

--enrollment-state.help: Filter by enrollment state (active, invited_or_pending, completed)

--env-type.help: Terminal backend type to evaluate against (default: local; isolated container backends like docker skip the guards)

--event-retention-days.help: Delete task_events older than N days for terminal tasks (default: 30)

--execute.help: Apply changes instead of reporting a dry run

--external-supervisor.help: Declare that an external process manager owns this foreground gateway. In-chat restarts and updates exit back to that manager instead of spawning a detached replacement. Use this when a launchd/systemd wrapper strips its native environment markers.

--fail-on.help: Exit non-zero when any finding meets this severity (default: critical)

--fake-boot.help: Enable deterministic desktop boot delays for validating startup UI

--file.help: Read message body from PATH (text only). Use '-' to force stdin. To send an image/document as an attachment, use MEDIA:<path> in the message text instead.

--first-release.help: Mark as first release (no previous tag expected)

--follow.help: Follow the log in real time (like tail -f)

--for-tool.help: Only fire hooks whose matcher matches this tool name (used for pre_tool_call / post_tool_call)

--force.help: Overwrite an existing bundle with the same name

--force-build.help: Force a full rebuild even if the content stamp matches

--force-config.help: Also overwrite config.yaml (normally preserved to keep user overrides)

--force-venv.help: Windows: mutate the venv even while other processes are running from its interpreter (desktop backend, gateway, terminals). Those processes keep native .pyd files locked, so the dependency sync will likely fail partway and strand the install half-updated. Use only if you know the detected holders are false positives.

--format.help: Export format (default: jsonl). 'trace' emits Claude Code JSONL for the Hugging Face Agent Trace Viewer

--from.help: Which tool to import from (default: pick across both)

--from-bitwarden.help: Treat secrets as managed by Bitwarden — discover provider keys from secrets.bitwarden config instead of the current env.  Fails loudly if BW is unreachable rather than silently falling back.

--full.help: Show full, untruncated service/log output where supported

--gateway.help: Gateway mode: use file-based IPC for prompts instead of stdin (used internally by /update)

--gateway-id.help: A stable id for this gateway instance (kill-switch granularity). Defaults to gw-<hostname>.

--goal.help: Run the worker in a goal loop: after each turn a judge checks the response against the card title/body and, if not done, the worker keeps going in the same session until the judge agrees it's complete (or the turn budget runs out, which blocks the card for review). Best for open-ended cards one shot rarely finishes.

--goal-max-turns.help: Turn budget for --goal workers (default 20). Ignored without --goal.

--gui.help: Uninstall only the desktop Chat GUI, leaving the agent intact

--gui-summary.help: Print a JSON summary of installed GUI/agent artifacts and exit (used by the desktop app to gate uninstall options)

--hermes-root.help: Override the Hermes source root used by Desktop (sets HERMES_DESKTOP_HERMES_ROOT)

--icon.help: Optional emoji or single-character icon for the dashboard

--id.help: Snapshot id to restore (see `--list`); default: newest

--idempotency-key.help: Dedup key for the root card

--ids.help: Additional task ids to promote with the same reason (bulk mode)

--ignore-existing.help: Force Desktop to ignore any hermes CLI already on PATH during backend resolution

--ignore-user-config.help: Ignore ~/.hermes/config.yaml and fall back to built-in defaults (credentials in .env are still loaded). Useful for isolated CI runs, reproduction, and third-party integrations.

--image.help: Optional local image path to attach to a single query

--in.help: Change into DIR before starting or resuming (scopes '--resume latest' / -c lookups to DIR's workspace).

--include.help: Run only the listed checks. Repeat for multiple (e.g. --include tcc_accessibility --include bundle_identity). Unknown names are reported by cua-driver.

--include-archived.help: Also delete archived sessions (excluded by default)

--include-manual.help: Even attempt servers marked manual-install (best effort)

--initial-status.help: Initial card status. Use 'blocked' for cards that require immediate human ops (R3 gate) to skip the brief running-to-blocked transition.

--insecure.help: Disable TLS verification for OAuth login

--inspect-only.help: Only report canonical table readability; do not create an output database

--installed-only.help: Only show servers whose binary is currently available

--instruction.help: Extra guidance prepended to the loaded skill content

--isolated.help: When launched from a named profile, run a dedicated server scoped to that profile instead of routing to the machine-level server. Default behavior is unified: profile launches attach to (or start) ONE machine-level server and preselect the profile.

--keep-orphans.help: Skip deleting projects whose workdir no longer exists

--kind.help: Typed block reason. 'dependency' waits in todo (auto-promoted when parents finish, no human); 'needs_input'/'capability' go to blocked for a human; 'transient' marks a maybe-flaky failure. Repeated same-kind re-blocks after unblock route the task to triage to break unblock loops. Omit for a generic block.

--language.help: Comma-separated language codes (e.g. en,tr). Default: auto

--lineage.help: md/qmd only: export one row or its compression lineage

--list.help: List available snapshots and exit without restoring

--live.help: Opt-in: run one bounded, read-only real-call health probe per configured tool backend (Firecrawl/FAL/browser/MCP/TTS/STT) after the static checks. Makes real network calls.

--local.help: Print the report locally instead of uploading

--log-retention-days.help: Delete worker log files older than N days (default: 30)

--long-description.help: Set Slack's long app description (175-4,000 characters).

--long-description-file.help: Read Slack's long app description from a UTF-8 text file (175-4,000 characters).

--manual-paste.help: Skip the loopback callback listener and paste the failed callback URL from your browser instead. Use this on browser-only remotes (GCP Cloud Shell, GitHub Codespaces, EC2 Instance Connect, ...) where 127.0.0.1 on the remote isn't reachable from your laptop. See #26923.

--max.help: Cap number of spawns per tick

--max-cost.help: Only match sessions costing <= N USD (actual or estimated)

--max-gap-seconds.help: Window between a keyed predecessor's last activity and an orphan's start for them to count as the same conversation (default: 900)

--max-len.help: Trim the stored comment body to this many characters

--max-messages.help: Only match sessions with <= N messages

--max-runtime.help: Per-task runtime cap. Accepts seconds (300) or durations (90s, 30m, 2h, 1d). When exceeded, the dispatcher SIGTERMs (then SIGKILLs) the worker and re-queues the task.

--max-size-mb.help: After orphan/stale prune, drop oldest commits per project until total size <= this (default 500)

--max-tokens.help: Only match sessions with <= N total tokens (input+output)

--max-tool-calls.help: Only match sessions with <= N tool calls

--max-turns.help: Maximum tool-calling iterations per conversation turn (default: 500, or agent.max_turns in config)

--metadata.help: JSON object with structured reviewer handoff facts.

--migrate-secrets.help: Include allowlisted secrets (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, API keys, etc.). Required even under --preset full.

--min-cost.help: Only match sessions costing >= N USD (actual or estimated)

--min-count.help: Minimum approval count for a pattern to be proposed (default: 2)

--min-messages.help: Only match sessions with >= N messages

--min-tokens.help: Only match sessions with >= N total tokens (input+output)

--min-tool-calls.help: Only match sessions with >= N tool calls

--model.help: Pin the worker to this model (passed as -m <model>) without changing the profile's configured model. Combine with --provider when the model belongs to a different backend than the profile's default.

--monitor-script.help: Set/replace the monitor source script (see `hermes cron create --monitor-script`). Pass empty string to clear.

--monitor-url.help: Set/replace the monitor source URL. Pass empty string to clear.

--name.help: Stored filename (default: the source file's basename)

--near.help: Address, city, or landmark to search around (geocoded via Nominatim).

--never-active.help: Instead of ended sessions, delete keyed gateway rows that were opened and never used (no messages, tokens, tool calls or title) and are older than AGE (default 30 days). Ordinary prune can never reach these — it only ever selects ended sessions

--newer-than.help: Only match sessions active within the last AGE (e.g. '5h', '2d') or after an ISO timestamp

--no-agent.help: Enable no-agent mode on this job (requires --script or an existing script on the job).

--no-allow-tool-override.help: Enable without granting built-in tool override (skip prompt).

--no-assistant.help: Omit Slack AI Assistant mode (assistant_view, assistant:write scope, assistant_thread_* events). DMs then render as a flat chat where bare slash commands (/help, /new) work inline instead of Slack's Assistant thread pane.

--no-bitwarden.help: Explicitly switch credential_source back to env on re-setup (only meaningful when the previous setup used --from-bitwarden).

--no-browser.help: Do not attempt to open the browser automatically

--no-enable.help: Install disabled (skip confirmation prompt); enable later with `hermes plugins enable <name>`

--no-redact.help: trace only: skip the forced secret redaction; only use after manual review

--no-restart.help: Do not restart a running daemon after setup; you'll need to run `hermes egress restart` yourself for changes to take effect.

--no-restore-cwd.help: Don't cd into a resumed session's recorded working directory.

--no-skills.help: Create an empty profile with no bundled skills (opts out of `hermes update` skill sync)

--no-start-now.help: Do not start the gateway service after installing

--no-start-on-login.help: Do not enable the service to start on login/boot

--no-supervise.help: Inside the s6-overlay Docker image, normally `gateway run` is automatically redirected to the supervised s6 service (so the gateway gets auto-restart on crash, plus a supervised dashboard if HERMES_DASHBOARD is set). Pass --no-supervise to opt out and get the historical pre-s6 foreground behavior: the gateway is the container's main process and the container exits with the gateway's exit code. No effect outside an s6 container.

--no-vacuum.help: Skip the final VACUUM (index is rebuilt but freed pages aren't returned to the OS until a later VACUUM)

--note.help: Optional short note attached to the heartbeat event

--notifier-profile.help: Profile gateway that owns/delivers this subscription (default: active profile)

--nous.help: Upload the debug bundle to Nous-internal storage (AWS S3) instead of a public paste service. The bundle is private — viewable only by Nous staff (and allowlisted Discord mods) via a Google-login-gated viewer — and auto-deletes after 14 days. Still force-redacts secrets unless --no-redact is also passed.

--oneshot.help: One-shot mode: send a single prompt and print ONLY the final response text to stdout. No banner, no spinner, no tool previews, no session_id line. Tools, memory, rules, and AGENTS.md in the CWD are loaded as normal; approvals are auto-bypassed. Intended for scripts / pipes.

--only.help: Export only a filtered view (user-prompts: one prompt record per line for jsonl, headed sections for md)

--output-dir.help: Where to write report, backups, and archived docs

--overwrite.help: Overwrite existing files (default: refuse to apply when the plan has conflicts)

--pass-session-id.help: Include session ID in system prompt

--payload.help: JSON payload to send (default: test payload)

--payload-file.help: Path to a JSON file whose contents are merged into the synthetic payload before execution

--phase.help: Run only the given phase(s); repeatable

--pid.help: Exact browser process id to authorize

--pidfile.help: Write the daemon's PID to this file on start

--plain.help: Print compact plain-text output instead of a Rich table

--play.help: Animate the build-up over time (Ctrl-C to stop).

--portal.help: One-shot Nous Portal setup: log in via OAuth, pick a Nous model, set Nous as the inference provider, and opt into the Tool Gateway. Skips the rest of the wizard.

--preset.help: Migration preset (default: full). Neither preset imports secrets — pass --migrate-secrets to include API keys.

--previous-interaction-id.help: for follow-up tasks that reuse earlier context

--project.help: Link to a project (id or slug). Anchors the task's worktree under the project's primary repo with a deterministic branch. See `hermes project list`.

--project-id.help: Pre-select a project UUID instead of prompting

--provenance.help: Only show skills of this origin

--provider.help: Provider the model belongs to (worker is spawned with --provider <name>). Cleared together with the model.

--public.help: trace --upload only: create/update a public dataset instead of private

--publish.help: Actually create the tag and GitHub release (otherwise dry run)

--quick.help: Quick snapshot: only critical state files (config, state.db, .env, auth, cron)

--quiet.help: Quiet mode for programmatic use: suppress banner, spinner, and tool previews. Only output the final response and session info.

--raw-query.help: Use query as raw Drive API query

--realtime.help: Also install realtime audio tools (pulseaudio-utils on Linux, BlackHole+ffmpeg on macOS). Uses sudo/brew, prompts before invoking either.

--reclaim.help: Release any active claim before reassigning (required if task is running)

--reconfigure.help: (Default on existing installs.) Re-run the full wizard, showing current values as defaults. Kept for backwards compatibility — a bare 'hermes setup' now does this.

--redact.help: Redact secrets (API keys, tokens, credentials) from exported content

--redirect-uri.help: Allow-listed localhost redirect URI for your Spotify app

--ref.help: Install exactly one immutable 40-character Git commit SHA

--refresh.help: Wipe the model picker disk cache and re-fetch every provider's live /v1/models list.

--release-file.help: Path to a release notes file to check for missing contributors

--remove-skill.help: Remove a specific attached skill. Repeatable.

--replace.help: Replace any existing gateway instance (useful for systemd)

--restart.help: If a daemon is already running, restart it automatically after writing the new config/tokens (non-interactive default on a tty is to ask).

--restore.help: Restore from official optional source, backing up existing matching copies

--result.help: Backfilled task result text for a done task

--resume.help: Resume a previous session by ID (shown on exit), or 'latest' for the most recent session

--retention-days.help: Drop projects whose last_touch is older than N days (default 7)

--reveal.help: Render the timeline built up to this point (0=oldest, 1=now).

--reviewer.help: Optional reviewer profile; reassigns the task before review dispatch.

--rm.help: Permanently delete already-archived task ids from the board

--rotate-tokens.help: Mint fresh proxy tokens for every provider (default is to preserve tokens for providers that already had one — avoids 401-ing already-running sandboxes on re-setup).

--run-as-user.help: User account the Linux system service should run as

--save.help: Save the recipe as .hermes/environment.json in the project

--script.help: Path to a script under ~/.hermes/scripts/. Pass empty string to clear. With --no-agent the script IS the job; otherwise its stdout is injected into the agent's prompt each run.

--server-url.help: Bitwarden region / self-hosted endpoint. Examples: https://vault.bitwarden.com (US, default), https://vault.bitwarden.eu (EU), or your self-hosted URL. Skips the interactive region prompt.

--setup.help: Run interactive Hermes provider/model setup for ACP terminal auth

--setup-browser.help: Install agent-browser + Playwright Chromium into ~/.hermes/node/ for browser tool support (idempotent).

--severity.help: Only show diagnostics at or above this severity

--show.help: Show current AI peer representation from Honcho

--show-keys.help: Show redacted API key prefixes (first/last 4 chars) instead of just set/not set

--show-tokens.help: Print the proxy tokens (default: redacted prefix only). Beware: tokens may persist in your shell history.

--since-tag.help: Git tag to start from (e.g., v2026.4.8)

--skill.help: Skill name to include (repeat for multiple)

--skill-conflict.help: How to handle skill name conflicts (default: skip)

--skin.help: Target a specific skin instead of the active one

--skip.help: Skip the listed checks. Repeat for multiple. Wins over --include.

--skip-build.help: Skip the web UI build step and serve the existing dist directly. Useful for non-interactive contexts (Windows Scheduled Tasks, CI) where npm may not be available. Pre-build with: cd web && npm run build

--skip-mcp.help: Skip scanning pinned MCP servers in config.yaml

--skip-sidecar-install.help: Skip `npm install` inside the sidecar directory

--skip-start.help: Run command phases but skip starting the app / readiness poll

--skip-venv.help: Skip scanning the Hermes Python venv

--slashes-only.help: Emit only the features.slash_commands array (for merging into an existing manifest manually).

--sort.help: Sort order: activity (most-used first, default), recent (most-recently-active first), or name (alphabetical)

--source.help: Session source tag for filtering (default: cli). Use 'tool' for third-party integrations that should not appear in user session lists.

--ssh-owner-nonce.help: Identify a Desktop-owned SSH backend process

--ssh-session-token-file.help: Read a one-shot Desktop SSH session token from PATH

--start-now.help: Start the gateway service immediately after installing

--start-on-login.help: Enable the service to start automatically on login/boot

--state-name.help: With --state-type: keep runs whose column equals this value

--state-type.help: With --state-name: filter runs by task_runs column

--step-key.help: Restrict to tasks with this current_step_key

--stop.help: Stop all running Hermes web server processes and exit

--store.help: Path to evidence JSON file (default: evidence.json)

--strict.help: Exit with code 1 if new unmapped emails are found (for CI)

--subject.help: Prepend a subject/header line before the message body.

--summary.help: What was implemented and how it was verified — shown to the reviewer.

--switch.help: Switch to the new board after creating it

--sync.help: Re-seed bundled skills immediately instead of waiting for update

--synchronous.help: Wait for the LLM review pass to finish (default for manual runs)

--system.help: Target the Linux system-level gateway service

--tail.help: Only print the last N bytes

--target-profile.help: Target a specific profile's Honcho config without switching

--task.help: Only show diagnostics for one task id

--technique.help: Apply a single technique by name

--tenant.help: When used with --all, restrict the sweep to this tenant

--text.help: Set description to this exact text (overwrites any existing description)

--text-only.help: Output plain text instead of JSON

--title.help: Only match sessions whose title contains this substring

--to.help: Delivery target. Format: 'platform' (home channel), 'platform:chat_id', 'platform:chat_id:thread_id', or 'platform:#channel-name'. Examples: telegram, telegram:-1001234567890:17585, discord:#ops, slack:C0123ABCD, signal:+15551234567.

--token.help: Provide the new token non-interactively (default: masked prompt)

--triage.help: Park in triage — a specifier will flesh out the spec and promote to todo

--tui.help: Force the Ink TUI / classic REPL

--until.help: Git ref to end at (default: HEAD)

--upgrade.help: Re-run the upstream installer even if cua-driver is already on PATH. The upstream install.sh always pulls the latest release, so this performs an in-place upgrade.

--upload.help: trace only: upload to your Hugging Face traces dataset instead of writing a local file (needs HF_TOKEN)

--usage-file.help: One-shot mode only: after the run, write a JSON usage report (estimated cost, token counts, model, api_calls) to PATH. The report is written even when the run fails, so pipelines can always account for spend. No effect outside -z/--oneshot.

--user.help: Only match sessions from this user ID

--wake-url.help: Phase 5 §5.2 wake URL: a reachable URL the connector pokes (payload-free GET) to wake this gateway when buffered work arrives while it's idle/suspended, so it reconnects and drains. Persisted as GATEWAY_RELAY_WAKE_URL in ~/.hermes/.env and forwarded at provision. Optional — without it the gateway still drains whenever it next reconnects on its own.

--window-id.help: Exact native window id (required for existing-profile attachment)

--work-dir.help: Existing directory for the disposable source copy (defaults beside the output)

--workdir.help: Absolute path for the job to run from (injects AGENTS.md etc. and sets terminal cwd). Pass empty string to clear.

--workflow-template-id.help: Restrict to tasks with this workflow_template_id

--workspace-target.help: Absolute path to copy workspace instructions into

--worktree.help: Run in an isolated git worktree (for parallel agents on the same repo)

--write.help: Write manifest to a file instead of stdout. With no PATH writes to $HERMES_HOME/slack-manifest.json.

acp.help: Run Hermes Agent as an ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server

add.help: Pick a provider + model (same picker as `hermes model`) and append to the chain

add-folder.help: Add a folder to a project

adopt.help: Hand unmanaged skills to the curator (provenance is a user declaration)

agent.help: Which agent to import from (default: auto-detect ~/.claude or ~/.codex)

ai-call.help: Place an outbound AI voice call via Bland.ai or Vapi

ai-status.help: Check an AI call status via Bland.ai or Vapi

approvals.help: Approval-prompt tools (mine history into allowlist proposals)

archive.help: Manually archive a skill (move to .archive/, excluded from prompt)

area.help: Get bounding box and area info for a named place.

assignees.help: List known profiles + per-profile task counts (union of ~/.hermes/profiles/ and current assignees on the board)

attach.help: Attach a local file to a task

backup.help: Take a manual tar.gz snapshot of ~/.hermes/skills/ (curator also does this automatically before every real run)

bbox.help: Find POIs within a bounding box.

bind-board.help: Bind a kanban board to a project

block.help: Mark one or more tasks blocked

boards.help: Manage kanban boards (one board per project / workstream)

browse.help: Interactive session picker — browse, search, and resume sessions

browser-approve.help: Mint a single-use token authorizing browser attachment for one exact window

bundles.help: Create, list, and manage skill bundles (aliases for multiple skills)

capabilities.help: Show declared vs granted capabilities per plugin

catalog.help: List Nous-approved MCPs available for one-click install

claim.help: Atomically claim a ready task (prints resolved workspace path)

clean-markers.help: Permanently clear stale tool-call marker content left by sessions from before #78148

cleanup.help: Archive leftover OpenClaw directories after migration
